nurse.text: Bienvenidos, croeso! The Sanctuary. The doctor speaks Spanish, the nurse speaks Welsh, and the creatures don't mind either.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them on the bed. There's a pot of tea on, naturally.
There. Fit to win a chair at the eisteddfod.
The Ark's by the window. It came all the way from Liverpool, like everything else in this valley.
